description: User-facing entry point for the wp-rocket issue workflow. Invoke directly to start a delivery run from a GitHub issue number, URL, or raw description. Runs inline in your conversation context; spawns specialist agents (ticket-writer, grooming-agent, challenger, backend-agent, frontend-agent, release-agent, lead-reviewer, qa-engineer) as isolated sub-agents; invokes supporting skills (knowledge-graph, dod, docs, issue-workflow) inline. Routes based on structured JSON outputs from each agent, manages loop counters, handles escalations, and maintains a live HTML run log.
